abilities.name: Ribbon of Influence
abilities.text: Once per round, draw a card and gain 1 additional victory point if the card is played immediately.

abilities.name: Shadow Step
abilities.text: Move through the crowd unnoticed, gaining initiative advantage on your next action.

abilities.name: Courtly Manners
abilities.text: Impress nobles with impeccable etiquette, gaining bonus charm for social encounters.

abilities.name: Intrigue Weave
abilities.text: Spin webs of deception, allowing you to redirect accusations to another noble.
